Messages.Author: Jan Willem Wijsman
Messages.Body:
Hi everybody,
Does pulled fangs work with catatonic fear? How about catatonic fear and
dawn operation?
Thanks, jw.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jan Willem Wijsman wrote:
> Does pulled fangs work with catatonic fear? How about catatonic fear and
> dawn operation?

Catatnic Fear (superior) deals its damage after the combat ends (errata -
which is necessary to have the damage done at all, given the rules
about how S:CE works). So the damage cannot be counted for purposes of
playing Pulled Fangs, and the damage will not be aggravated under a
blocked Dawn Operation.
